ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: If there was an increase in elk, what would happen to grasses?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The picture is a food web; on the right side the "Elk" label can be seen, at the bottom to the right the "Grasses" label can be seen, and there is an arrow from "Grasses" pointing to "Elk", indicating that elk eat grass. Then reason: If the number of elk increases, the consumers that eat grass become more numerous, and grass will be consumed more, so the amount of grass will decrease.
